title.en: Structured data from notes · format-preserving transformation

user_goal.ko: 비정형 메모를 지정한 JSON 필드로 변환해줘 (형식 보존 변환)
user_goal.en: convert unstructured notes into the requested JSON fields (format-preserving transformation)

task.expected_artifact: A target-format rewrite that preserves the source meaning and constraints.

messages.content: 지역 생활 정보와 공공 안내를 확인하는 상황에서 비정형 메모를 지정한 JSON 필드로 변환해줘. 입력 상황: 필드는 title, owner, deadline, priority이고, 메모에 없는 값은 null로 두기로 했어. 지정한 형식으로 바꾸되 숫자·날짜·조건·주체의 의미는 그대로 보존해.
지역 생활 정보와 공공 안내를 확인하는 상황 관련 건이야. 필드는 title, owner, deadline, priority이고, 메모에 없는 값은 null로 두기로 했어.
비정형 메모를 지정한 JSON 필드로 변환해줘.
지정한 형식으로 바꾸되 숫자·날짜·조건·주체의 의미는 그대로 보존해.

In a local-life information and public-notice context, convert unstructured notes into the requested JSON fields. Input context: the fields are title, owner, deadline, and priority, and values absent from the notes must be null. Convert to the requested format while preserving the meaning of numbers, dates, conditions, and actors.
This is about a local-life information and public-notice context: the fields are title, owner, deadline, and priority, and values absent from the notes must be null.
convert unstructured notes into the requested JSON fields.
Convert to the requested format while preserving the meaning of numbers, dates, conditions, and actors.

invariants: Use null for absent values and retain the stated wording.
Return only the requested JSON structure.
failure_signals: Returning prose outside the requested structure.
